RCAN1 isoform 4 (RCAN1. 4), an inhibitor of calcineurinin, is upregulated by VEGF in endothelial cells, and is required for VEGF-stimulated cell polarity and migration.

RCAN1 regulates VEGF-mediated internalisation of VEGFR-1 and VEGFR-3 in human microvascular ECs and is essential for the establishment of endothelial polarity in response to the growth factor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and functional characterization of the role of RCAN1 isoforms in the regulation of angiogenesis and endothelial cell function in vitro and in vivo.

RCAN1 is a novel regulator of VEGF signalling and angiogenesis.
RCAN1 is an essential regulator of VEGF-mediated endothelial cell migration, polarity and sprouting angiogenic responses.
RCAN1 isoforms are important regulators of VEGFR-1 and VEGFR-3 internalisation and endothelial cell migration in vitro.

RCAN1 isoforms regulate the calcineurinin-NFAT signalling pathway, which is important for endothelial cell function.

RCAN1 is an important factor in the regulation of endothelial cell migration, polarity, and sprouting angiogenic responses.
